purpose: vLLM <-> HF parity gate (B7-3) for Qwen3.5-0.8B: joins VLLM_PARITY_MODELS only on PASS
rule: scripts/qa/vllm_hf_parity.py v3 (fixed before these runs; gap judged at 3 decimals): base passes 1 same input / 2 no anomaly / 5 trunc+parse within 2 points; the fine-tune passes all five, quality-informative
data: CORD-v2 test[0:100] PNG folder, prompt 'Read this receipt and return its fields as JSON.', pixels 200704-1003520, greedy, max 1024 tokens, no thinking; HF batch 1 bf16 (vlm-automodel:26.08-6), vLLM 0.31 kv 8 GB logprobs 5

truncated_rows.pattern: each forks at an early near tie (token 3-84, gap 0.0-0.5); HF then loops (repeated keys) to 1024 tokens while vLLM stops: a greedy property of a small base, not an engine fault, but condition 5 is decisive on the base

fine_tune.model: R7 merged, outputs/graph/runs/n8-610449f0ba21f6cd/merged (Qwen3.5-0.8B LoRA 1 epoch, 797 CORD train images)
fine_tune.note: HF field F1 82.69 = a data point for R7 (1 epoch, checkpoint not chosen on validation), not a published score

decision: not added to VLLM_PARITY_MODELS under rule v3; an exception (e.g. vLLM only for 0.8B fine-tunes) would be a PM decision with its reason, and needs a code change (the list is keyed by catalog id)
caveats: vLLM greedy is not bit-reproducible run to run
